cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Started the Weirdness
cards.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The cups are floating. I'll tie them down while you rescue breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You flicked that gravity switch reaching for the toaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Could've been the toaster. Give me the string; I'll secure everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole table's rising. Hold my ankles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got you. I'll anchor us to the radiator. Let's list what floated, not who touched what.

mechanism: A corrects incident priorities and records to hide a casual gravity-switch mistake while actively securing floating household objects.
confusable: D133 denies responsibility generally; D157 specifically hides a small initiating choice while eagerly managing impossible consequences.
comparison: A physical anchoring emergency differs from distracting a word-eating demon with the causal object.
seedUse: Keep accidental switch and escalating float; avoid requiring unspoken staging to place B on the table.
